seats.name: Target & Attribute Parity Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies 1:1 semantic alignment of targets, deps, sources, flags, idiomatic Bazel visibility scoping (true rdeps only, no :__pkg__ or //:__subpackages__), and that the change modifies only build-definition files (no source edits).

seats.name: Dual-Build & Sentinel Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies #LOCAL_BAZEL_BUILD_SENTINEL, bazel2gn synchronization, Bazel-first visibility parity, and build-only change scope in dual-build packages.
